reviewMethod: Independent model-blind dense re-review of frozen 40-ID request: one sequential OpenCV decoder at a time, cv2.setNumThreads(1), bounded per-record thumbnails. All decoded frames from actual PTS 0 through first >=4 s visually inspected in 80 ordered full-frame sheets using view_image; seven sampled enlargement sheets also opened. No seeks, nominal-FPS timestamp reconstruction, audio, full-motion playback, model predictions or old-label approval.
limitations: Provisional assistant visual judgments for training selection, not human truth. Prior labels and publisher archive categories are provenance, not approval. This is re-review of 40 existing training sources, not 40 new sources.

Every consecutively decoded source frame from index zero through first actual CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC >= 4000 was placed in ordered primary sheets and visually opened with view_image. Contact sheets are still images, not full motion playback. No audio was inspected; no identity, intent, injury or relationship is inferred.

Primary RGB thumbnails fit within 320x182 pixels. Faces are source-blurred; distance, compression, occlusion, dark areas and framing limit interpretation. Seven supplementary enlarged sampled views clarify small subjects/contact; they do not replace primary every-frame coverage.

Time is actual sequential OpenCV CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC after each successful read, never reconstructed from nominal FPS. Monotonic PTS and small gaps establish decoder-level continuity only; no independent demux/packet audit or real-world capture completeness is asserted.

Only explicit 0-4 second intervals are annotated normal. Boundary evidence may extend slightly beyond 4 seconds, but all tails after 4 remain unannotated and absence beyond observed coverage is not verified. Declared duration is inherited inventory metadata; full-tail duration was not independently decoded.

All VID remains one unresolved actor/session training cohort. Scene groups describe backgrounds, not independent sessions. No calibration, holdout, production accuracy or live promotion claim. No fight-positive labels, inference, GPU work or training performed.

previousReviewReferences.coverageBasis: Provisional assistant visual inspection using local OpenCV (cv2.setNumThreads(1)): 16 timestamped RGB samples spanning each of 102 clips (0.1 seconds through duration minus 0.1), read as real contact sheets with view_image. For 20 candidate windows, sequentially decoded the first four seconds and retained 32 evenly spaced timestamped frames from 0 through approximately 4 seconds, visually inspected with view_image; 12 windows retained. No continuous playback or full-frame-by-frame inspection; no audio review. Only explicit 0-4 second source spans are labelled normal; unknown tails remain unannotated.
